constructionChain.change: Delete three private trace inverse coordinates and their sole-use equations.
Replace the product scales by two aggregate-trace scales and retain the fixed coefficient as A=80989^(2*N+1).
Remove twelve private odd-index coordinates; apply the invertible affine input substitution giving beta=51*X^2+2504; replace scalar shift 4896 by 9792.

Use three effective sum-height scales; remove six product coordinates and twelve private odd-index coordinates; copy the second detector into the third and remove its obsolete scale square; apply the certified affine input substitution.
Combine local tests of orders 1, 10, 40 using distinct valuation classes; reuse existing powers; remove unused symmetric products and q40 powers.
Combine local tests of orders 1, 10, 40 using distinct valuation classes; reuse existing powers; remove unused symmetric products and q40 powers.
Use powers q,q^19,q^79 with a shared reciprocal cube; replace scalar coordinate by the actual contact product using an invertible rational affine change and primitive residual normalization.
Use powers q,q^19,q^79 with a shared reciprocal cube; replace scalar coordinate by the actual contact product using an invertible rational affine change and primitive residual normalization.
Four disjoint contact blocks give height exponent19/4; even valuations and shorter logarithms permit local orders12/3, reference depth3, and five factors. Both normalization equations are changed.
constructionChain.role: Coefficient dependency only; no integer-projection claim for this literal intermediate table.

constructionChain.change: Use even reciprocal-abscissa valuations, four factors, and formal reference depth10; retain comparison orders and global thresholds.
Share degree-twenty contact evaluations and remove redundant quadratic coordinates. This is a coefficient dependency; the current projection proof uses the later normalized circuit.
Directly impose F20(t)e=(t-1)^20 at both detectors; remove scaled numerator powers and use the positive quarter-trace itself. The projection is proved from these literal equations.
Use twenty contacts symmetric about one and direct F20*q=r^9 normalization; remove two coordinates per detector with a complete projection proof.
Balanced contact normalization makes inverseR affine; nineteenth-power weights give comparison order ten. The independent checker reconstructs directly from family267.
Eight symmetric contacts and fourth-power height scale under ordinary abc; joint quadratic inverse evaluation and affine input-comparison coordinate.
Ten reflected contacts, seventh-power local weights, plain formal parameters, and scalar eighth-power denominator under the proved modular height bound.
Fourth-power scalar denominator from the cubic logarithmic height bound and sharpened Lucas estimate; independently verified forced prime149. The checker reconstructs directly from family259.
Three quadrics in four common-point field coordinates, direct alternate ratios, and an exact invertible rational six-row change. All exceptional cases are proved.
Four-coordinate common-point chart and denominator-normalized numerator logarithms; the effective height argument excludes exceptional denominator classes before any quotient is used.
Three effective comparison scales and the explicit modular multiplicity height estimate.

Reciprocal factor clearing removes stored fourth powers. In the inherited-premise constructions the sharper contact-height theorem also permits comparison precision three; this change has a separate arithmetic proof.
Four factors encode sixteen local tests; shared comparison fourth powers give a net saving of one coordinate across three comparison scales.
